title: Smooth coefficient localization of the explicit Popescu polynomial quotient
statement: Let k and A be commutative rings with a k-algebra structure on A. Let d,n,m be natural numbers, a:Fin m→A, and j:Fin m. Suppose A_(a j) is smooth over k [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map]. Define P=A[X_i,Z_(i,l)] [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] and B=P/(X_i^n−Σ_l Z_(i,l)a_l) [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient], with k[X_i]-algebra structure sending each X_i to its quotient class. Then B_(a j) is smooth over k[X_i]. No finite-presentation assumption on A, singular-ideal generation, or positive exponent is required.

proof.text: Fix j and invert a_j. For each row i, solve uniquely for Z_(i,j) as a_j inverse times (X_i^n minus the sum over l distinct from j of Z_(i,l) a_l). Evaluation on these formulas and inclusion of the other variables induce mutually inverse maps between the localized quotient and A_(a_j)[X_i,Z_(i,l), l distinct from j]. Verify the equations and compositions on coefficients and variables by the universal properties of quotients, polynomials, and localization. These maps preserve the k[X_i] structure.

The algebra A_(a_j)[X_i] is obtained by base change from the assumed smooth k-algebra A_(a_j). The remaining finite polynomial algebra is smooth over that algebra. Compose these smooth maps and transport across the equivalence. Empty row sets and zero localizations are included; the elimination formula works for n=0 as well.

lean.statement:
theorem popescuPolynomialCoefficientLocalization_smooth
    {k : Type u} {A : Type v} [CommRing k] [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    (d n : ℕ) {m : ℕ} (a : Fin m → A) (j : Fin m)
    (hj : Smooth k (Localization.Away (a j))) :
    let P := MvPolynomial (Fin d ⊕ (Fin d × Fin m)) A
    let B := P ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin d ↦
      MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i) ^ n -
        ∑ l : Fin m, MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inr (i, l)) * MvPolynomial.C (a l)))
    let f : MvPolynomial (Fin d) k →ₐ[k] B :=
      MvPolynomial.aeval (fun i ↦ Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (MvPolynomial.X (Sum.inl i)))
    letI := f.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    Smooth (MvPolynomial (Fin d) k) (Localization.Away (algebraMap A B (a j)))
